text.text_excerpt: We found The Treme Hotel thru airbnb and LOVED our stay! At first we were skeptical... but after the excellent southern hospitality, and secure stay at night... we were happy as can be! The owners cooked up some amazing BBQ one night and offered to us. They gave us a ride so we didn't have to call a cab one evening, also. Great stay, clean rooms, clean bathroom. For the reasonable price, excellent hospitality and very clean grounds - I will stay here every time I'm in NOLA!

This hotel is nestled in a quaint neighborhood, with convenient access to the Quarter. The staff was friendly, courteous and very helpful to their customers. The room was wonderful, with a Kind bed, a sofa (with a bed), microwave and refrigerator, not to mention a full shared kitchen downstairs, a work out room, another restroom and outside grills and tables to relax. It was a wonderful experience (not my first NOLA trip) and I would definitely stay at the Treme, again!

This place was perfect.. We were coming to New Orleans from Texas to visit some family for a birthday party and it got pretty late... So we decided to look for a hotel to stay in...well...we didn't know that there was a convention in town, so everywhere was booked, and even the roughest places were either booked or ridiculously overpriced...so I just kept searching for a hotel, and it's almost midnight! Finally I heard a nice gentleman answer the phone at The Treme who had rooms available. It was clean, great price,security cameras,and to my surprise its in the heart of everything!
